claim_tested: Diamine preference of PP_2928 is readable from its substrate pocket
key_finding: 242 PF03435 sequences (>=30% id to 38LX) split into three discrete pocket types with no intermediates. PP_2928 is Type II (I108/H109/D251, n=66, 64/66 Pseudomonadota), which contains no assayed enzyme. Loop type predicts clamp identity perfectly, Fisher p=1.78e-51; type tracks phylum, chi2=227.8, dof=12, p=5.78e-42.
context: Alignment to 38LX chain A observed sequence, BLOSUM62 affine -11/-1, own Needleman-Wunsch implementation (no MSA service was reachable)
confidence_limitations: High confidence in the typing itself (pairwise alignment verified structurally: AlphaFold Q88IS1 on 38LX, 340 Ca, RMSD 1.11 A). Pairwise rather than progressive alignment; no phylogeny was inferred, so 'subfamily' here means pocket type plus taxonomic coherence, not a supported clade.

stance: refutes the published recognition-loop model as a discriminator
claim_tested: The DTANYE loop and Glu251 distinguish putrescine users from agmatine users
key_finding: H. pylori O26037 and C. jejuni Q0PBW7 (putrescine CASDHs) carry exactly the same N108/Y109/E110/I206/E251 as the assayed agmatine enzymes B. fragilis I9VY56, C. leptum A7VSG1 and Synechocystis Q55131. Identity at all five positions across both substrate outcomes.
context: 38LX auth numbering; 38LX is the only agmatine-bound structure in the family (1.19 A, ligands NDP, AG2)
confidence_limitations: Based on the five positions within 4.5 A of bound agmatine. A discriminator outside this shell, or a dynamic one, is not excluded; PMID 42754158 itself reports large ligand-dependent domain and loop motions.

stance: supports the substrate assignment by exclusion, not by pocket
